name: Nila Dhuma
source:
In a mysterious and extraordinary train 4 people from different places and different times gather, it seems that they are united by the same incident in some way or another, but still is not clear why they have been gathered there, why they were chosen to ride that mysterious train?

[From [url=https://eidolon-stigma.itch.io/nila-dhuma]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一辆神秘而非凡的列车上，来自不同地点、不同时间的四个人聚集在一起，似乎他们因同一件事而以某种方式团结在一起，但仍不清楚为什么他们会聚集在那里，为什么他们会被选中乘坐那辆神秘的列车？

[来自[url=https://eidolon-stigma.itch.io/nila-dhuma]itch.io[/url]]
